title: 屋頂綠化排水與防水
summary: 以「綠屋頂的水、重量與防水界面」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow water, weight and waterproofing interfaces in green roofs through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.failure: 以乾密度檢核結構會漏掉蓄水重量。
steps.failureEn: Checking with dry density omits stored-water mass.
steps.check: 列出各層飽和質量，與結構設計資料對照。
steps.checkEn: List saturated layer masses and compare with structural design data.
